The value is canonical MessagePack `pm.storage_value.collaboration_projector_checkpoint.v1@1.0.0`, defined at `Plans/collaboration_projection_contracts.schema.json#/$defs/checkpoint`: schema identity; `publication_id`; `storage_instance_id`; `scope_kind`, `scope_partition` and `project_id` (null in application scope); `projector_id` and `projector_version`; `admitted_event_types`, the sorted exact list of these families admitted in the registry when the publication was built; `index_read_token`, SP-278's nine-field durable read token (DL-076), never `redb_snapshot_id`; the examined bounds `first_retained_sequence_id` and `index_through_sequence_id` and SP-278's inclusive `source_cursor`; `filter_complete`, `state` (`current`, `degraded`, `withdrawn`), `health`, `updated_at_utc`, `withdrawn_at_utc`, `published_at_utc`, `hold_refs` and at most two `retired_generations`.

**Numeric and type interpretation.** The new semantic-body and typed-snapshot SHA-256 domains use sorted-key, compact UTF-8 JSON (DL-077), with lossless decimal/exponent decoding before any binary64 conversion.
